title: proposal-design-split
description: Root node for splitting Cartographer proposal work into lightweight proposal, requirements, design, and plan phases.

title: Proposal workflow skill
description: Current proposal workflow creates proposal.md plus map/fact JSONL and includes the detailed Design section inside proposal.md.

title: Planning workflow skill
description: Current planning workflow creates plan.md plus plan.nodes.jsonl and plan.edges.jsonl from an accepted proposal.

title: Implementation workflow skill
description: Implementation consumes plan artifacts and keeps plan.md, plan.nodes.jsonl, receipts, and context-packs authoritative during execution.

title: Cartographer README
description: Documents the current proposal -> plan -> implement workflow and supporting artifact set.

title: JSONL validation and summary helper
description: Validates topic artifacts and summarizes plan/fact/context/receipt records; likely extension point for requirements JSONL validation.

title: Planning graph validator
description: Validates plan graph, proposal citations, receipts, context packs, and no-private-reference rules; likely extension point for requirements/design graph checks.

title: Cartographer State Discipline
description: Project guidance that .plan proposal, plan, receipt, and context-pack artifacts remain authoritative and must not be duplicated casually.

title: OpenSpec concepts
description: OpenSpec describes behavior specs as source of truth, change folders, proposal/design/tasks artifacts, delta specs, and archive merging.

title: OpenSpec getting started
description: OpenSpec getting-started docs describe proposal, specs, design, tasks artifacts and ADDED/MODIFIED/REMOVED delta requirements.

title: requirements.md
description: Proposed human-readable behavioral requirements artifact generated after proposal acceptance and before design.

title: requirements.nodes.jsonl
description: Proposed graph-backed requirement, scenario, acceptance-check, and delta nodes with stable IDs.

title: requirements.edges.jsonl
description: Proposed requirement graph edges linking requirements to facts, proposal goals, design decisions, plan tasks, validations, receipts, and durable specs.

title: design.md
description: Proposed separate design artifact that receives the current proposal's detailed design/architecture/research synthesis content after requirements exist.

title: Durable project requirements
description: Proposed permanent project-level requirements document analogous to docs/adr; accepted topic/change requirement deltas fold into this file, with optional split files if it grows too large.

title: Durable ADR directory
description: Existing durable project-level ADR documentation pattern that docs/requirements.md should mirror for permanent behavioral requirements.

title: design.nodes.jsonl
description: Proposed machine-readable design graph nodes for decisions, alternatives, components, interfaces, migrations, risks, and validation strategies with stable IDs and requirement references.

title: design.edges.jsonl
description: Proposed machine-readable design graph edges linking design nodes to requirements, facts, map nodes/files, alternatives, plan phases, validations, and receipts.
